newsitem.title: UK: Astra CEO does not exclude change in Astra Merck.
newsitem.headline: Astra CEO does not exclude change in Astra Merck.

text.p: The chief executive officer of Swedish pharmaceutical company Astra AB said on Monday that he did not exclude ownership changes in Astra Merck, the 50/50 joint venture of Astra and U.S. Merck.
The cooperation is, however, working well, CEO Hakan Mogren told a seminar.
"We have not discussed any changes yet...Things change and we are open for adjusting," Mogren said.
At the moment, both Astra's marketing organisations in the U.S., Astra Merck and Astra USA, are concentrating on product launches, Mogren stressed.
Astra Merck plans to make Astra's blockbuster anti-ulcer agent Losec the most sold drug in the U.S. and Astra USA will launch anti-asthma agent Pulmicort Turbuhaler this spring.
